name: San Juan de Betulia (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and green, the white with a white disc at the hoist bearing two clasped hands, the green charged with a yellow eight-pointed star at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of San Juan Betulia, a municipality in the department of Sucre, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.
